## door v0.1.7 — the greeter fills the panel (black-strip fix)

This release fixes the long-standing **black strip along the bottom of the door
greeter** on the physical panel. The greeter now renders edge-to-edge at the
native mode; login, PAM, and the sandbox are unchanged.

### Fixed
- **Greeter black strip on the physical eDP panel** — a ~35px black band at the
  bottom of the pre-auth greeter (visible on the panel, but *absent* from every
  `grim` screenshot, which is what made it so slippery to pin down). Root cause:
  door-greeter left `decorations: true` (the iced default) in its window
  settings. cage advertises no server-side-decoration protocol, so winit fell
  back to **sctk-adwaita client-side decorations** — a `HEADER_SIZE = 35`
  titlebar. winit subtracted 35 from the 1080 toplevel (content buffer →
  1920×1045) and placed the header subsurface at `(0, −35)`, off the top of the
  screen. The bottom 35 rows of the 1080 panel were left covered by no buffer →
  scanned out black. Because the strip lived on the **scanout path**, not in the
  composited buffer, screenshots always looked clean.
  **Fix:** `decorations: false` in `door-greeter`'s `window::Settings`
  (`door-greeter/src/app.rs`) → `winit .with_decorations(false)` → no Adwaita CSD
  frame → the greeter's own content fills the full 1080. door already draws its
  own chrome, so nothing visual is lost.

### Notes
- **Confirmed on real hardware.** Verified headless first (production fullscreen
  path, `WLR_BACKENDS=headless`): the fixed build shows the main content buffer
  filling the full output, zero `set_position(0, −35)`, and zero 1920×35 shm
  header buffer — all of which the broken build produced. Then confirmed
  **on-panel at next boot**: the strip is gone, the greeter renders edge-to-edge.
- **Rules out the earlier suspects.** PSR (`enable_psr=0`) and direct-scanout
  (`WLR_SCENE_DISABLE_DIRECT_SCANOUT=1`) were both ruled out during the
  investigation — neither ever moved the strip, because there was genuinely no
  buffer covering those rows in any compositing path. Overscan and FBC were never
  involved. Full trail: `.agent/REPORTS/2026-07-03-greeter-blackstrip-investigation.md`.
